As Anthropic prepares for its IPO, sources indicate that the filing will highlight AI backlash as a significant risk factor, which could influence investor sentiment. In the aerospace sector, Airbus has responded to remote working demands following a series of strikes, reflecting a broader trend of workforce flexibility that may reshape corporate culture.
